Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA comer Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City http: //www.dilg.com.ph CILG OPINION NO. & S. 2020 MS. CHARIS O. GARMA LGOO vr Municipal Local Government Operations Office Pinili, Ilocos Norte Dear LGOO Garma: 24 This has reference to your letter dated 06 January 2020 asking clarification on whether or not elected Punong Barangay Leonardo N. Espiritu of Barangay Sacritan, Pinili, can assume his position after having been granted of Probation on 16 December 2019 in Criminal Case Nos. 5803-18 and 5804-18. Your aforesaid letter was forwarded to the Central Office by DILG-Region I Director James F. Fadrilan for appropriate action. As culled from the documents forwarded to the Central Office, hereunder are the relevant factual antecedents: • Leonardo N. Espiritu (hereinafter referred to as "PB Espiritu") was the duly elected Punong Barangay of Barangay Sacritan, Pinili, Ilocos Norte; He was charged before the Regional Trial Court-Branch 18, Batac, Ilocos Norte docketed as Criminal Case Nos. 5803-18 and 5804-18. The nature of the charges however was not disclosed in the documents forwarded to the Central Office; Be that as it may, in a Joint Order dated 16 December 2019, the Application of PB Espiritu for Probation was granted by the aforesaid Court. Pertinent portion of the aforesaid RTC Joint Order reads: WHEREFORE, the Application for Probation is GRANTED. The Jail Warden of the Batac District Jail is ordered to release the accused from detention for him to comply with the conditions of the probation, unless he is being detained for other unlawful causes. Upon failure on the part of the probationer to comply with any of the foregoing conditions or upon a showing of any material misrepresentation in his application for probation, the grant may be revoked and he be made to suffer the penalty originally imposed on him. SO ORDERED. " Hence, your subject letter.

Probation, as defined under Section 3 of Presidential Decree No. 968, as amended, is a disposition under which an accused, after conviction and sentence, is released subject to the conditions imposed by the court and to the supervision of a probation officer. In probation, the execution of the sentence is suspended, including the suspension of the execution of its accessory penalties. This is evident from Section 4 of PD 968 (as recently amended by Republic Act No. 10707), thus: SEC. 4. Grant of Probation.- xxx The trial court shall, upon receipt of the application filed, suspend the execution of the sentence imposed in the judgment. (Emphasis Supplied) In Moreno vs. COMELEC, et al.l, the Supreme Court En Banc held: xxx the accessory penalties of suspension from public office, from the right to follow a profession or calling, and that of perpetual special disqualification from the right of suffrage, attendant to the penalty of arresto mayor in its maximum period to prision correccional in its minimum period imposed upon Moreno were similarly suspended upon the grant of probation. It appears then that durinq the period of probation, the probationer is not even disqualified from runninq for a public office because the accessory penalty of suspension from public office is put on Che duration Qf Che probation. Clearly, the period within which a person is under probation cannot be equated with service of the sentence adjudged. Sec. 4 Of the Probation Law specifically provides that the qrant of probation suspends the execution of the sentence. During the period of probation, the probationer does not serve the penalty imposed upon him by the court but is merely required to comply with all the conditions prescribed in the probation order. (Emphasis Supplied) Taking into account the foregoing as regards the effect of probation and considering that the RTC has placed accused PB Espiritu under probation for a period of six (6) years, to be reckoned from the date he will report for supervision to the Probation Office, Laoag City, there is no legal impediment for him to re-assume his post and he could, therefore, legally continue to discharge the powers, duties and functions pertaining to the Office of the Punong Barangay. Thank you. Very truly yours, AUTHORITY OF THE SILG Unde Ls/LRALLD/17M Copy furnished: DIR. JAMES F. FADRILAN Regional Director, DILG-Region I Aguila Road, San Fernando City, La Union 1 G.R. No. 168550, 10 August 2006. M TIN B. DINO retary for Barangay Affairs
